resources.name: Delivery Service Full Scenario
resources.description: Run login requests first - each saves its JWT token into an environment variable (e.g., {{ jwt_admin }}, {{ jwt_alice }}, {{ jwt_shop }}, {{ jwt_courier1 }}). Then run any protected request - it will automatically use the saved token.

resources.name: Delivery Service Scenarios
resources.description: Delete and re-import this one parent folder if needed. Run requests in order from top to bottom against a fresh database.

resources.name: 00. Authentication (Login)
resources.description: Login as different users to get JWT tokens. Tokens are valid for 24 hours.

resources.name: 01. Helpers
resources.description: Endpoints that work with any authenticated user.

resources.name: 10. Happy Path
resources.description: Creates customer id 2, courier id 3, and order id 1.

resources.name: 20. Shop Decline Path
resources.description: Creates customer id 4 and order id 2.

resources.name: 30. No Courier Path
resources.description: Creates customer id 5 and order id 3. Works best after happy path so courier id 3 is unavailable.

resources.name: 40. Invalid Requests
resources.description: Negative tests for auth failures, validation, pagination, etc.
